summary: Iteration 3 testing: AceIt AI rename, credit costs, question bank stats, chat no-limit, chapter names, subscription page. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests PASSED. Frontend: Fixed 'NeuraLearn' bug on AuthPage (renamed to AceIt AI). All core features verified: auth login, /auth/me, question bank stats, quiz=15cr, mock=30cr, no daily chat limit, top performer in gold, syllabus shows clean chapter names. Found one pre-existing backend bug: duplicate 'starter' plan in subscription plans API.

minor.issue: Returns 5 plans instead of 4 — 'starter' appears twice. Root cause: plan_gates.py line 111: PLANS['pro_legacy'] = PLANS['starter'] adds a duplicate entry to the dict, so list(PLANS.values()) includes starter twice. Fix: either remove pro_legacy from PLANS dict or exclude it from the list_plans response.

ui_bugs.issue: Auth page logo showed 'NeuraLearn' (gradient-text 'Neura' + text-white 'Learn') instead of 'AceIt AI'. FIXED in this iteration — updated lines 67-69 to use 'AceIt' / red ' AI' spans.

issues: Duplicate 'Starter' plan card appears (5 cards instead of 4) — shows Free, Starter, Pro in row 1 and Elite, Starter (duplicate) in row 2. Backend API issue (plan_gates.py pro_legacy).

action_items: Fix duplicate 'starter' in PLANS: In plan_gates.py line 111, remove or exclude PLANS['pro_legacy'] from the list_plans API response. Quick fix: in subscription.py list_plans(), filter to only show plans where id matches the key (exclude pro_legacy).
AuthPage.jsx NeuraLearn->AceIt AI rename: ALREADY FIXED by T1 in this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: plan_gates.py line 111: PLANS['pro_legacy'] = PLANS['starter'] causes list(PLANS.values()) to return 'starter' twice. Fix in subscription.py: return {'plans': [p for p in PLANS.values() if p['id'] in PLANS]} or deduplicate by id.
AuthPage.jsx logo was not renamed from NeuraLearn → AceIt AI (lines 67-69). Fixed: changed to AceIt AI.
curriculum_engine.py: Class 12 Mathematics shows duplicate chapters (Part 1 + Part 2 have identical names). Not a new bug but may confuse users — consider deduplicating by chapter_no per book_title.
SyllabusPage.jsx correctly shows only ch.name (no chapter number prefix) — feature is working as intended.

chat.py: Daily message limit (check_limit) correctly removed for ai_message. Variable credit deduction (deduct_credits_for_chat) correctly implemented. CHAT_WORD_LIMIT=1000 soft-cap with warning injection working.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (AuthPage fixed; duplicate plan card on pricing page is a backend API bug)

rca_of_issue: 1. AuthPage NeuraLearn bug: AuthPage.jsx lines 67-68 were not updated during the AceIt AI rename. The two spans still had class='gradient-text' and 'Neura'/'Learn' text. Root cause: incomplete rename — IntroScreen.jsx, Sidebar.jsx, OnboardingModal.jsx were updated but AuthPage.jsx was missed. Fix: replace with AceIt/AI spans matching other components. 2. Duplicate starter plan: plan_gates.py line 111 does PLANS['pro_legacy'] = PLANS['starter'], which adds a second entry with key 'pro_legacy' but value identical to 'starter'. list(PLANS.values()) then yields 'starter' dict twice. Fix: add a filter in list_plans() to deduplicate by id.
